quarterly_data.quarter: Bloom Energy press release: Bloom Energy Introduces Power Connect, Cutting Onsite Power (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bloom introduced Power Connect, a new deployment system that moves critical electrical integration from the construction site to the factory: it arrives pre-connected, pre-wired, tested and ready for installation, and Bloom says it can reduce onsite power installation time by over 40% (company claim), easing reliance on scarce skilled electrical trades. Power Connect is manufactured and assembled in the United States through Bloom's network. Joe Tavi, Head of Bloom's Customer Installation Group, called it 'the latest innovation supporting our speed-to-power advantage'. No availability date, volumes or pricing stated.
quarterly_data.figure: onsite installation time reduced by over 40% (company claim)
